driver_scope: base.js + unchanged single case body + separate fixed Setup/run/TearDown driver; one execution per Benchmark; not V8 Score, adaptive timing, or an ordinary release profile
measurement_scope: instrumented logical events; callsite observer only ordinary-driver enter_selected; counters are not time, CPU instructions or full call/construct coverage

coverage_scope.fusion_basis: logical-profiled-events; no timing; executed-functions-only; max 4096 functions, 16384 sites per category, 4 callee identities per callsite
coverage_scope.callsite_scope: ordinary-driver-enter-selected-only; other call and construct paths are excluded
